skills.name: agent-reach
skills.note: Not from npx skills add -- own installer drops a SKILL.md directly, so it's tracked by name here instead of source. See https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach. Hermes install is intentionally omitted -- the installer only targets Claude Code/Cursor today (it writes to ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills). Add a hermes key here once we have a verified hermes install command.

skills.name: clickable-brief
skills.note: Hand-authored directly through an agent session -- no external source to pull from, so the dotfiles copy under local-skills/clickable-brief/ IS the source of truth (not a stale mirror of something else).

The 'Animations on the Web' course skill set (animations.dev). One installer call produces all of these. Requires animationsdev_token in ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml's [data] section (a personal license token -- never hardcode it here, this file is public on GitHub).

skills.name: herdr
skills.note: Installed via npx skills add but shows source:null in `npx skills list --json` on this machine -- tracked by name to match its actual detected state.

skills.name: pullimg
skills.note: Hand-authored pullimg skill for Ghostty drag-drop over SSH. local-skills/pullimg/ is the source of truth.

skills.name: yuanbao
skills.note: Yuanbao groups skill. local-skills/yuanbao/ is the source of truth.

marketplaces.name: tutor-marketplace
marketplaces.note: Local dev marketplace. Only reproducible on a machine that has the tutor repo cloned at exactly this path. sync will not auto-add this on a fresh machine.

plugins.note: Depends on the non-portable tutor-marketplace above.

hermes._comment: Hermes state here is the real ZimaBoard instance (ssh zima), not this Mac's local ~/.hermes shell/client. Skills are shared top-level; agents.hermes.skills is for Hermes-only extras.

pi._comment: Placeholder. No 'pi' binary or config exists yet. Adding real support later is data-only: add entries to top-level skills with an install.pi, then add 'pi' branches to the detect_/sync_/drift_ functions in sync-agent-tools.sh. No new hook mechanism needed.
